title: Coverage recovery Wave 02 part 9 — Breez and Satochip lifecycle depth
notes: Candidate IDs are provisional and must be reallocated against fresh main during canonical promotion. Breez maintenance-mode evidence is treated as a support/lifecycle change rather than a shutdown; the repository explicitly remains maintained for critical bug fixes and security issues. Satochip v0.12 is a dated hardware-wallet applet update, not an inferred original product launch.

events.title: Breez Mobile documented maintenance mode
events.description: The official Breez Mobile repository documents that the project is in maintenance mode: it remains maintained for critical bug fixes and security issues, while new features, enhancements, and non-critical updates are no longer planned.

events.title: Satochip applet v0.12 released
events.description: Satochip applet v0.12 was released with SeedKeeper encrypted-seed import support, card labels, offline 2FA reset support, factory reset support, and card-authenticity PKI support.

evidence.title: Breez Mobile Client official repository
evidence.notes: Official repository explicitly states Maintenance Mode and defines the reduced support scope. Event date records the observation date because the repository text does not provide the date maintenance mode began.
